english.title: Driver failing to produce driver's record book

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: DRIVERS HOURS GOODS VEHICLES KEEPING OF RECORDS REGULATIONS

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an employee-driver, failed to produce your current driver's record book for inspection on being required to do so by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),

(A)_[the employer who issued the book to you]_
(B)_[a person in relation to whom you were, during the period of the currency of the book, an employee-driver]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 9(2) of the Drivers' Hours (Goods Vehicles) (Keeping of Records) Regulations 1987 and section 98(4) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes: Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant, who was employed as a driver of a goods vehicle and who was the holder of a driver's record book, failed to produce it to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..),

(A)_[the employer who issued the book,]_
(B)_[a person who employed the defendant whilst the book was current,]_

on being requested to do so.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
